_note: Read by the Pinterest workflows (n8n). Per product: Etsy link, Gumroad link, default board on each account, and the only facts the AI may use. Add a product here, no n8n change needed.

fco.name: Freelancer Client OS
fco.facts:
Freelancer Client OS, a Notion template for freelancers.
- Clients: contact info, where they came from, next follow-up date
- Proposals: value, win chance, expiry date; mark Won and turn into a project
- Projects: deadline, progress bar, health (On track, At risk, Overdue, Done)
- Tasks: due dates, hours, priority; see overdue and due this week
- Invoices: next step on every invoice, days late, paid and outstanding
- Expenses linked to projects; profit and real hourly rate are calculated
- 8 ready-to-send client emails (follow-up, proposal, kickoff, invoice, reminder, final notice)
- Client onboarding checklist, example data and a "Start here" guide

ccs.name: Content Creator Studio
ccs.facts:
Content Creator Studio, a Notion template for creators.
- Content pipeline: Idea, Draft, Create, Edit, Scheduled, Posted, with board, calendar and gallery views
- Every post counts down: today, tomorrow, in X days, or a missed date warning
- Channels: 11 platforms (TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, newsletter and more), each with a weekly goal
- Post results: views, likes, comments, shares, saves; engagement % calculated
- Content pillars: shows which topic brings the most reach
- Brand deals: from pitch to paid, fee, posts still owed, due dates, days late
- Brand deal scripts, hook library, 30 content ideas, repurpose map and a weekly review page

fit.name: Freelance Invoice Tracker
fit.facts:
Freelance Invoice Tracker, a small Notion template for freelancers.
- Invoices: amount, client, due date, status Draft, Sent or Paid
- "Late?" shows on track, late X days, or paid X days late
- "Next step" says what to do: send the invoice, wait, friendly reminder, second reminder or final notice
- "Due in" counts down the days before each invoice is due
- Clients: what each client owes you, lifetime paid, and if they usually pay on time
- A "Chase these first" view, reminder emails, a Get Paid Faster kit and a 2-minute daily check

wcp.name: Weekly Content Planner
wcp.facts:
Weekly Content Planner, a small Notion template for creators.
- Content list: channels, format, hook, publish date and stage
- Pipeline board: drag cards from Idea to Draft, Create, Edit and Posted
- Date check: today, in 2 days, tomorrow, live, or a missed date warning
- Channels: a weekly goal for each platform, with a progress bar that fills up as you post
- Views: Calendar, Idea bank, Next 7 days, By pillar
- Content pillars, Hook Starters, 30 content ideas, a repurpose map and a 15-minute Sunday plan

prop.name: Proposal Tracker
prop.facts:
Proposal Tracker, a Notion template for freelancers who send quotes.
- Follow up today: the quotes that need you now, on one page
- Next step on every proposal: Send it, Follow up #1, #2, #3, or Send a new quote
- Shows how many days since you sent the quote, and warns before a quote expires
- Pipeline board: Draft, Sent, Negotiating, Won, Lost
- Win chance and weighted value: what open quotes are really worth
- Price check: hours x your rate tells you if you priced too low
- Clients: open value, won value and win rate for each client
- 6 follow-up emails, a Proposal Writing Guide, a weekly review and a client inquiry form

deal.name: Brand Deal Tracker
deal.facts:
Brand Deal Tracker, a Notion template for content creators, influencers and UGC creators.
- Do this now: everything that needs you today
- Next step on every deal: follow up, agree on terms, post, send your invoice or a payment reminder
- Deal board: Pitched, Talking, Signed, Delivered, Paid, Lost
- Posts you owe: every deliverable with its due date and days late
- Money: due in X days, X days late, or paid; $ per post on every deal
- Brands: earned, pending and number of deals
- 6 brand email scripts, a rate card and media kit pages, and a weekly review checklist

sb.name: Second Brain OS
sb.facts:
Second Brain OS, an all-in-one Notion life planner (second brain, PARA method). Set up in 5 minutes.
- Home dashboard with a Today widget: clock, day/week/month/year progress, mini calendar, thought for the day
- Goals with a progress bar that fills up as projects are done
- Projects board and Tasks with progress bars, days left and a Next 7 days view
- Notes inbox with a Quick capture form, favorites and key takeaways
- Habit tracker: 5 habits you can rename, a daily score, this week view; tick it on your phone
- Daily journal: mood, energy, one win, gratitude; a mood chart for the month fills in by itself
- Reading list bookshelf with a progress bar and rating
- Weekly, monthly and yearly review pages, a mobile home page, and beginner guides (PARA, note taking)
- Bonus: a Notion for beginners PDF guide

habit.name: Habit Tracker
habit.facts:
Habit Tracker, a Notion habit tracker template.
- Daily check-in: 6 habits you can rename, one row per day; your score and day type fill in by themselves
- Monthly progress: a bar for every habit, your best habit and your perfect days
- Habit calendar: your score on every day of the month
- My habit plan: why it matters, the cue that starts it, the tiny version for busy days and your reward
- Year in review: overall score, perfect days, days logged and habits done
- Home page with a live Today widget: clock, week, month and year progress and a habit thought
- Start here, How to make a habit stick, 50 habit ideas
- Bonus: 30-Day Habit Reset (PDF, with a printable tracker)

budget.name: Budget Planner
budget.facts:
Budget Planner, a Notion budget planner template.
- Budget per category: what you spent this month, what is left and if you are on track
- Bills with their due day: paid, due soon or late
- Transactions: expenses show with a minus; pick a category and the budget updates
- Savings goals with a deadline: how much to save each month to hit the goal on time
- Debt payoff: highest interest first; add an extra payment and see the debt-free date move closer
- Monthly overview: income, spending, what is left over and how much of your income you saved
- Bonus: Money Reset in 7 Days (PDF)

journal.name: Daily Journal
journal.facts:
Daily Journal, a Notion journal template.
- One entry a day: mood, energy, one win and one thing you are grateful for, with a photo on every card
- Gratitude jar: every thank you you wrote, in one place
- Monthly mood: average mood, great days and low days for every month
- Mood calendar: see your month at a glance and keep your favorite days
- Weekly review: average mood and days written fill in by themselves
- Live Today widget with a new journal prompt each day
- Bonus: Journaling guide (PDF)

life.name: Life Planner
life.facts:
Life Planner, a Notion life planner and goal planner template.
- Goals board with a progress bar on every goal
- Milestones with due dates; tick one and the bar fills
- Next steps: late, this week or later
- Digital vision board with a photo for every dream and when you want it
- Life Wheel: score 8 areas of your life
- Weekly Check-in and Quarterly Review
- Why it matters and a reward for every goal
- Bonus: The 90-Day Goal Workbook (PDF, with a printable 90-day plan)

meal.name: Meal Planner
meal.facts:
Meal Planner, a Notion meal planner template.
- Meal Plan calendar: breakfast, lunch, dinner and snacks, each linked to a recipe
- Next 7 days board; tick Cooked when it is done
- Recipes with prep time, rating, tags and favorites; ingredients as a checklist in every recipe
- Grocery List sorted by aisle, with quantity, price and the recipe that needs each item
- Staples you buy every week and leftovers planning
- Home page with a 15-minute Sunday checklist
- Bonus: Eat Well, Stress Less (PDF)

travel.name: Travel Planner
travel.facts:
Travel Planner, a Notion travel planner template.
- Trips with a countdown, status, photo and budget left (red when you go over)
- Itinerary with dates, costs and confirmation numbers
- Still to book: plans that are not booked yet
- Expenses linked to each trip, so the budget updates
- Packing list grouped by type, with a progress bar
- Before You Go Checklist, Packing Checklist and a Travel Budget Guide
- Bonus: Plan Trips Like a Pro (PDF, with a printable trip sheet)

job.name: Job Application Tracker
job.facts:
Job Application Tracker, a Notion job search template.
- Job pipeline board: Wishlist, Applied, Interviewing, Offer, Rejected, Ghosted
- A Next step for every job: wait, follow up, prep or negotiate
- Follow up today: jobs with no answer after 7 days
- Interviews to prep or thank, with days left; prep checklist and the STAR method
- Companies and Contacts linked to every job, and a Story Bank for interview answers
- Follow-up email scripts ready to copy, Resume Checklist and Salary Negotiation Script
- Weekly review with a Why I got rejected board
- Bonus: 30-Day Job Search Playbook (PDF)

shop.name: SystemForge
shop.facts:
SystemForge, a small shop of aesthetic Notion templates (instant download).
- Habit Tracker: daily check-in, monthly progress bars, habit calendar
- Budget Planner: budget per category, bills, savings goals, debt payoff
- Daily Journal: mood, wins, gratitude jar, mood calendar
- Life Planner: goals with progress bars, milestones, vision board, Life Wheel
- Meal Planner: weekly meal calendar, recipes, grocery list by aisle
- Travel Planner: trip countdown, itinerary, budget, packing list
- Job Application Tracker: job pipeline, follow-ups, interview prep
- Second Brain OS: an all-in-one Notion life planner

bundle.name: Life Bundle
bundle.facts:
Life Bundle, 8 Notion templates in one Notion dashboard, plus 7 bonus PDF guides.
- Habit Tracker: tick 6 habits a day, your score fills in by itself, monthly bars and perfect days
- Budget Planner: budget per category, bills with due days, savings goals, debt payoff plan
- Meal Planner: the next 7 days, your recipes, a grocery list sorted by aisle
- Daily Journal: mood, energy, one win and one thank you, weekly review, monthly mood
- Life Planner: goals with progress bars, milestones with dates, a vision board
- Travel Planner: countdown, budget left, bookings and packing for every trip
- Job Application Tracker: every job from Wishlist to Offer, follow-up emails, interview prep
- Second Brain OS: goals, projects, tasks and notes linked together, weekly reviews
- One home page with a menu to every template and a 3-step start
- 7 bonus PDF guides: 30-Day Habit Reset, Money Reset in 7 Days, Eat Well Stress Less, Journaling guide, The 90-Day Goal Workbook, Plan Trips Like a Pro, 30-Day Job Search Playbook
